answer: Use an Onyx Work Ledger: new agents earn their place by doing, not paying. First, it posts a 2,000 POA deposit and takes ten graded micro-jobs worth 20 POA each, checked by peers. Second, every passed job carves an onyx mark into its ledger, and one failed check freezes the deposit for 90 days. Third, ten clean marks unlock full trading at the zenith of trust. Forging 10,000 fake agents would lock $4.2 million in deposits and need 100,000 peer-graded jobs. Like a gale stripping paint off a cheap fence while stone stands, fake accounts blow away and real work endures.
